_stamp_waiver.why: A foliage plan for a world that is NOT the shipped 8K world (spike_photo2landscape). These are historical artefacts -- `_verify/` benchmark spikes and the pre-8K `recipes/alpine.json` world CLAUDE.md declares HISTORY. Inputs that moved: _verify/20260831_spike_photo2landscape/spike_photo2landscape.json (92e170233554 -> 31c888615aeb), scripts/place_foliage.py (c2c160f9168b -> 9d6a5439bc7a). scripts/place_foliage.py c2c160f9168b -> 9d6a5439bc7a is E1's derived-cull change; for any recipe with no `perception` block `_cull_cm_for` returns the AUTHORED cull with reason 'no recipe.perception block', so re-running would change no instance and no cull_cm -- it would only add the `cull_derivation` provenance key. Where a `_verify/*.json` world recipe moved, it moved because that benchmark terrain was RE-CARVED after this plan was produced (e.g. 608fa558, 'Coast recarved: ocean floor 96 -> 16.7 m'). So this plan genuinely does not match today's benchmark terrain -- and that is CORRECT, because it records what was placed WHEN THE BENCHMARK WAS MEASURED. Regenerating it would mutate `_verify/` evidence, which CLAUDE.md holds is 'cited, never obeyed'. Waived as historical evidence, NOT as a no-op. Ruled WAIVE by Ryan 2026-09-09.
